# Verification-scripts index

*Auto-generated by `make_verify_index.py`. Do not edit by hand — rerun the script.*

The drift is harmless — each script is run by path (`python <path>`) and its in-folder references are self-consistent — but this table is the key so it stays navigable. To run everything, use `verification/VERIFY_ALL.py` (the aggregate rope-check), not these per-paper scripts.

## Note on the legacy names

A `legacy` row means the script's filename keeps the J-number the paper had *before* renumbering; the science is unaffected. Two papers were made fully folder-consistent on 2026-09-22 (J43 → `verify_J43_S4_closure.py`, J29 → `verify_J29.py`) because their references were actually broken/wrong; the rest are left named-as-is and simply mapped here to avoid a large, low-value rename sweep.
